A [[Falleen]] [[Gender|female]] '''child''' was captured by a group of [[Zygerrian]] [[Enslaver|slave traders]]<ref name="Rampage" /> in approximately [[19 BBY]].<ref name="Rampage date">"[[Rampage (episode)|Rampage]]" takes place some time after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|founding]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], an event that ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]].</ref> She, along with a [[human]] and a male Falleen adult, were kept by the slavers in the ruins of [[Old Ord Mantell City]] on the planet of [[Ord Mantell]], overseen by the Zygerrian leader, [[Raney]].<ref name="Rampage" />

In around 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],<ref name="Rampage date" /> a [[Clone Force 99|renegade clone squad]] took a [[bounty]] job to [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Clone Force 99)|rescue]] a child named [[Muchi]] from the slaver's base in [[Old Ord Mantell City]] and at first, they erroneously thought the Falleen girl was Muchi. The clones successfully distracted the Zygerrians by releasing a caged [[rancor]], allowing them to free the Falleen prisoners. However, when one squad member, [[Omega]], addressed the girl as Muchi, the Falleen prisoner communicated that it was not her who was Muchi, but the rancor. Regardless, the clones freed and safely escorted both Falleen to a pair of [[speeder bike]]s at the south entrance of the city. There, the Falleen thanked their rescuers and then escaped the city with the child.<ref name="Rampage" />
